learned: 2026-10-09, by an agent: rawthentic.com is WooCommerce with the public Store API: 489 products, no variations (one page per product), prices 0 (a brand site, not a shop). Papers, cones and tips are 127 of them; the rest is apparel, trays, glass, storage and gear.
notes: The site's categories name the line: RAW Classic, RAW Black, RAW Organic Hemp, RAW Ethereal (papers); Classic Cones, Black Cones, Organic Hemp Cones; RAW Classic Tips, RAW Filters. Connoisseur, Artesano, Creaseless and Masterpiece are ranges inside a line. Lines are read by the rules in data/product_lines.json (merch_catalog.reading), the same rules that read a store's listing, so the two agree by construction.

A page has no size variants. The width is in the title ('RAW Classic Kingsize', 'RAW Classic 1¼ Cones') or the SKUs (RAWKSWIDE, RAWK-SSLIM: the wide and the slim); the retail pack counts are in the copy ('available in a 6 Cone Pack, 32 Cone Pack, 500 bulk box', '50 leaves per pack'). merch_catalog.site_sizes reads both and leaves out bulk and display boxes (a distributor's unit). A page that names no count gives its widths with the count open, so a store's '32ct' of it joins.
Out: parchment, glass tips and holders (gear, not papers), and everything outside Papers, Cones and Tips.

Retail counts per width (merch_counts), 2026-10-09, from the site's copy checked against retailers (smokecartel.com, Costco, Leafly): papers 1¼ 50, 1½ 33, single wide 50 or 100 (double feed; Black only 100), king size slim and wide 32, Creaseless 1¼ 300/500 (Organic 300) and Supreme 40; cones 1¼ 6/20/32 and king size 3/20/32 (Black has no 32, Ethereal only 6 and 3). An empty list (Artesano and Masterpiece 1¼) means no count was found: the page's own count, if any, is kept. A page names its widths and counts separately ('available in 1¼ and King Size... 50 and 32 leaves'), so without the table they multiply into sizes RAW does not sell.

Sizes the site's pages leave out (merch_sizes): Artesano in king size slim, 32 leaves + tips + tray. The Classic Artesano page shows only its 1¼ SKU though its copy says King Size Slim; the pack is sold as 'Classic Artesano Kingsize Slim' (amazon.com/dp/B0773BJPMQ, owner 2026-10-09), and Organic Hemp Artesano KSS 32ct at stores (Kaya Bliss) and smokecartel.com.
